name: engineering-skills
description: Claude skills that help developers build, review and ship web apps on Next.js, React and Firebase. Three plugins: eng for the whole repo, fe for the frontend and be for the API, plus the official Vercel, Firebase, Upstash and Cloudinary skills they use.

plugins.name: eng
plugins.description: Skills for the whole repo of a Next.js and TypeScript project: AGENTS.md, file structure, naming, TypeScript, Zod schemas, the monorepo, env and secrets, tests, CI, scaffolding, upgrades and commits, plus repo-wide audits and a pull request review. Comes with fe and be.

plugins.name: fe
plugins.description: Frontend skills for Next.js and React: components, semantic HTML, accessibility, Tailwind CSS, the design system, Storybook, search and AI visibility, product copy, browser security, cookie consent and icons, plus audits for each. Includes eng.

plugins.name: be
plugins.description: Backend skills for an API on Next.js and Firebase: route structure, the OpenAPI reference, sign-in, permissions, rate limits, plans, audit logs, security, field encryption, Firestore, Redis, image uploads, Cloudinary, feature flags, maintenance mode, email and webhooks, plus audits. Includes eng.

plugins.name: extension-to-functions-codebase
plugins.description: Skill for converting an installed Firebase Extension (or extension source) into a standalone Cloud Functions for Firebase codebase or publishable npm package, including V1 to V2 trigger upgrades, lifecycle hooks, and declarative security

plugins.name: firebase-app-hosting-basics
plugins.description: Deploys and manages full-stack web applications (Next.js, Angular) with Server-Side Rendering (SSR) using Firebase App Hosting. Use when deploying Next.js/Angular apps, configuring apphosting.yaml or firebase.json apphosting…

plugins.name: firebase-security-rules-auditor
plugins.description: Audits Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Storage) security rules for vulnerabilities, privilege escalation, role bypasses, create vs update inconsistencies, resource exhaustion, type safety, size limits, and hasOnly ownership checks.…

plugins.name: upstash-ratelimit-js
plugins.description: Rate limiting for serverless and edge apps with the @upstash/ratelimit TypeScript/JavaScript SDK backed by Upstash Redis. Use when adding a rate limiter or throttling to an API route, Next.js middleware, Vercel Edge, Cloudflare…

plugins.name: cloudinary-docs
plugins.description: Looks up implementation details in the latest Cloudinary docs via the relevant llms.txt file. Use when building code or answering questions relating to image or video uploads, management, SDKs, APIs, webhooks, or integrations.…

plugins.name: cloudinary-transformations
plugins.description: Create and debug Cloudinary transformation URLs from natural language instructions. Use when building Cloudinary delivery URLs, applying image/video transformations, optimizing media, or debugging transformation syntax errors.

plugins.name: turborepo
plugins.description: Build system guide for JavaScript and TypeScript monorepos with task caching and parallel execution.

plugins.name: next-dev-loop
plugins.description: Verify Next.js runtime behavior after editing app code, through the dev server's MCP endpoint and a browser. Requires a running next dev.

plugins.name: next-cache-components-adoption
plugins.description: Turn on Cache Components in a Next.js app and resolve the blocking routes it surfaces.

plugins.name: next-cache-components-optimizer
plugins.description: Grow the UI a Next.js route shows immediately on a hard or soft navigation, guarded by a failing instant() e2e worked to green.
